name: Certificate of Incorporation
download_note: Bilingual official PDF, Dept. of State. Filing also available online via the Estado portal.

name: Articles of Organization
download_note: New LLCs/corps register through the Dept. of State's electronic registry (Registro de Corporaciones y Otras Personas Jurídicas); no public blank LLC PDF on the forms page.

name: Certificate of Authorization to Do Business (Foreign Corporation)
download_note: Bilingual official PDF, Dept. of State. Requires attached certificate of existence from home jurisdiction.

name: Limited Liability Partnership Registration
download_note: Bilingual official PDF, Dept. of State. Registration valid 1 year from filing.

name: DBA / Trade Name Registration
download_note: No reachable online form on 2026-09-11: PR trade-name filings go through the Dept of State's online Sistema de Registro de Marcas y Nombres Comerciales, whose portal (prtmfiling.estado.pr.gov) was unreachable. File or inquire via the Dept of State corporate registry.

name: IRS EIN Confirmation Letter
download_note: Apply free online; the IRS issues the EIN confirmation (CP 575) on completion. Paper path: Form SS-4 PDF at irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fss4.pdf.

name: Merchant Registration Certificate (Registro de Comerciante)
download_note: No paper form: Hacienda administers merchant registration solely through SURI since 2018; the certificate is issued/printed from the portal.

name: SURI Account Registration
download_note: Create the SURI account directly on Hacienda's SURI portal.

name: Permiso Único
download_note: No standalone form: OGPe's official applicant manual states filing is 100% electronic via the Single Business Portal at ogpe.pr.gov.

name: Zoning / Use Certification
download_note: Filed electronically through OGPe's Single Business Portal; no standalone form.

name: Occupancy Documentation
download_note: Use/occupancy handled inside the OGPe Single Business Portal; no standalone form.

name: Patente Municipal
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: No statewide form: each municipality's finance office issues its own PA02 (provisional) / PA01 (annual declaration) — e.g. Aguada, Caguas, Guaynabo publish their own PDFs. Get it from the business municipality's finance office.

name: Municipal Registration
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Municipality-dependent: register/file with the business municipality's finance or permits office; no single official form.

name: Municipal Tax Compliance Certificate
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Issued by the business municipality (finance office); no centralized form. Request a debt/compliance certification there.

name: Health / Sanitary Permit
download_note: Sanitary/health endorsement is processed inside OGPe's Permiso Único (Secretaría Auxiliar de Salud Ambiental); no standalone form.

name: Fire Safety Certification (Certificado de Bomberos)
download_note: Certificación de Prevención de Incendios (CPI) processed through OGPe; an inspection by the Cuerpo de Bomberos underlies it.

name: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
download_note: No government form: CFPM is a private ANSI-accredited certification (e.g., ServSafe). Obtain through an accredited provider; the certificate is uploadable evidence.

name: Alcohol Beverage License
download_note: Internal Revenue license application and renewal moved into SURI; the paper SC 2309 is legacy.

name: Professional License
download_note: Official Dept of State portal (operated by Didaxis) for examining-board credential requests: exams, licenses, certifications, renewals.

name: Contractor License
download_note: Official DACO PDF on docs.pr.gov (Regulation 8172 contractor registration). Matches the DACOUC01 source SmartPR maps as a fillable artifact.

name: Tourism Registration
download_note: Register as a hostelero/room-tax contributor with CTPR's División de Impuestos de Habitación to get your hotelier ID (required before monthly room-tax returns).

name: General Liability Insurance Certificate
agency_note: Not government-issued — request the declaration page or coverage letter from the business's own insurance carrier.
download_note: No government form: obtained from the business's licensed insurance carrier/agent (e.g., ACORD certificate). Upload the issued certificate as evidence.

name: Workers Compensation Insurance (CFSE)
agency: Corporación del Fondo del Seguro del Estado
agency_canonical: Corporación del Fondo del Seguro del Estado
download_note: Mandatory state workers-comp policy: use CFSE's Servicios en línea para Patronos (payroll declaration, policy payment, compliance certificates).

name: Lease Agreement
agency_note: Not government-issued — provided by the landlord/property owner (e.g., lease, written authorization).
download_note: Private contract between tenant and property owner; no government form. Upload the signed lease as evidence.

name: Property Deed (Escritura)
download_note: Created by a PR notary (notario) at purchase; recorded at the Property Registry (ridpr.pr.gov). Obtain a certificación registral from the registry if needed.

name: Floor Plans
agency_note: Not government-issued — a private licensed professional prepares/seals it; verify their license via the Dept. of State Examining Boards portal.
download_note: Prepared and sealed by a licensed architect/engineer; no government form. Upload the sealed plans as evidence.

name: Environmental Permit
download_note: No single form: DRNA authorizations are program-specific (air, water, waste, tree cutting). Most business environmental compliance is folded into OGPe's Permiso Único; program-specific forms live under drna.pr.gov permit pages.

name: Medical Waste Management Permit
download_note: Program-specific DRNA/JCA authorization; no single public form verified. Consult DRNA for the applicable permit.

name: Sign / Rótulo Permit
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Handled via OGPe Permiso Único or the municipality depending on location; no standalone official form.

name: Outdoor Seating Authorization
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Municipality-dependent authorization; apply at the municipal permits office. No centralized form.

name: Entertainment Permit
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Municipality/Hacienda-dependent; no single official form. Check the municipal permits office.

name: Import / Export Registration
download_note: Import declarations and monthly import returns are filed through SURI (Hacienda).

name: Home Business Declaration
agency_note: No single URL — the issuing office depends on the municipality; contact the mayor's office / permits office of the municipality where the business operates.
download_note: Municipality-dependent; some municipalities fold it into the Permiso Único domiciliario in OGPe. Check the municipal permits office.

name: CRIM Property Tax Clearance
download_note: CRIM certifications (debt clearance, account statements) are requested through the official CRIM360 portal.

name: Transportation / PUC Permit
agency_canonical: NTSP (Negociado de Transporte y Otros Servicios Públicos)
download_note: Official NTSP site for franchise/transport-service authorizations; many filings processed via renovacionesonline.com (per NTSP guidance).

name: Commercial Vehicle Registration
download_note: Official CESCO page listing driver/vehicle service forms and requests (registration, transfers, duplicates, renewals).

name: Childcare / Education License
download_note: Licensing under Law 173-2016 is handled by the Dept of Family licensing offices (orientations + regional application). ACUDEN's portal is the official entry point.

name: Background Check Documentation (Certificado de Antecedentes Penales)
download_note: Official pr.gov online application/validation wizard for the Policía PR criminal-background certificate. Free online.

name: Pesticide Applicator License
agency_note: UNVERIFIED BY FETCH — the agency site (www.agricultura.gobierno.pr, listed as official in its Wikipedia infobox) was unresponsive/blocked during verification; confirm before shipping this link.
download_note: No single online form verified: restricted-use pesticide applicators are trained/examined through the UPR Servicio de Extensión Agrícola and certified by the Dept of Agriculture.

name: Bona Fide Farmer Registration
agency_note: UNVERIFIED BY FETCH — the agency site (www.agricultura.gobierno.pr, listed as official in its Wikipedia infobox) was unresponsive/blocked during verification; confirm before shipping this link.
download_note: No single online form verified: the Certificación de Agricultor Bona Fide is issued by the Dept of Agriculture through its regional offices.

name: Weapons / Firearms Dealer License
download_note: Official Policía PR Form PPR-329 (rev. 4/2020) for the firearms license under Law 168-2019.

name: Nonprofit Registration / 501(c)(3) Determination
download_note: PR side: Dept of State nonprofit-corporation categories form. Federal 501(c)(3): apply via IRS Form 1023 on Pay.gov (no blank PDF).

name: Traffic Impact Study (Estudio de Impacto Vehicular)
agency: Departamento de Transportación y Obras Públicas (DTOP) / Municipal Engineering
download_note: Engineering study prepared by a licensed engineer for DTOP/municipal review; no government form.

name: Stormwater Management Plan (NPDES MS4)
download_note: The SWPPP itself is prepared by the project engineer; federal stormwater coverage in PR is obtained by filing the NOI electronically through EPA's CGP-NeT (CDX).

name: Noise Variance / Endoso de Ruido
download_note: No single form verified: noise-level variances are petitioned to DRNA under the Reglamento para el Control de la Contaminación por Ruidos (municipalities may also have local noise ordinances).

name: Commercial Solid Waste Collection Contract
download_note: Private contract with an authorized waste hauler or municipal service; no government form.

name: Off-Street Parking Compliance Certificate
agency_note: No single URL — most permits are filed through OGPe's Single Business Portal (sbp.ogpe.pr.gov); autonomous municipalities run their own offices (e.g., San Juan: tramite.sanjuan.pr).
download_note: Issued via the municipal permits office / OGPe Permiso Único process; no standalone form.

name: Commercial Loading / Unloading Zone Permit
agency_note: No single URL — most permits are filed through OGPe's Single Business Portal (sbp.ogpe.pr.gov); autonomous municipalities run their own offices (e.g., San Juan: tramite.sanjuan.pr).
download_note: Municipality-dependent (traffic/permits office); no centralized form.

name: San Juan Municipal Use Permit (Permiso Municipal de Uso)
agency: Municipio de San Juan — Permisos Municipales
download_note: Use permits in the Municipio Autónomo de San Juan are processed by its Oficina de Permisos (Edificio Trilito, Ave. José de Diego 940) through the Single Business Portal.

name: Historic Facade Preservation Plan
download_note: Official ICP requirements sheet for Patrimonio Histórico Edificado endorsements (façade interventions, exterior painting, signage in historic zones). Actual application is filed with ICP's PHE program.

name: Historic District Structural Review
download_note: Official ICP requirements for historic-property endorsements; the recommendation is required before OGPe/municipal permits in historic zones.

name: Historic-District Sign Variance
agency: Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña (ICP) + Municipal Permits Office
download_note: Official ICP requirements sheet including 'Recomendación de Instalación de Rótulo o Anuncio' (signage in historic zones).

name: ATM Ferry Logistics Manifest (Vieques/Culebra)
download_note: No public form verified: cargo manifests for the Vieques/Culebra ferries are coordinated with the ATI maritime operator (ati.pr.gov).

name: NPDES Industrial Discharge Permit
download_note: Official EPA page with fillable PDFs: Form 1 (all applicants) + Form 2C (existing industrial) / 2D (new). PR is an EPA-issued-permit jurisdiction.

name: RCRA Hazardous Waste Handler ID (40 CFR 262)
download_note: EPA Region 2 (covers PR) page: file EPA Form 8700-12 by mail or electronically via myRCRAid/RCRAInfo to obtain the RCRA Site ID.

name: Port Facility Operating Authorization
agency: Autoridad de los Puertos de Puerto Rico
download_note: No single form verified: issued by the Autoridad de los Puertos for operations inside port facilities; contact the Authority for the applicable permit.

name: Title V Air Emission Permit
download_note: PR runs its own Part 70 air program via DRNA (not federal EPA Title V). Official page with permit-form downloads and filing instructions (email to secretariaaire@drna.pr.gov + pre-intervention ticket).

name: CBP Customs Broker Bond
download_note: Official CBP page with direct Form 301 PDF download (1MB, updated 04/30/2024). Form also filed electronically via CBP surety process.

name: TSA Known Shipper / Indirect Air Carrier
download_note: TSA cargo programs page: Indirect Air Carrier applications go through the online Indirect Air Carrier Management System (IACMS); known-shipper status via the carrier.

name: Airport-Area Concession Agreement
agency: Aerostar Airport Holdings / Autoridad de los Puertos
download_note: Private agreement with Aerostar Airport Holdings / Autoridad de los Puertos; no government form.

name: Condo / HOA Short-Term Rental Authorization
agency_note: Not government-issued — provided by the owner or the HOA board (authorization letter, HOA approval).
download_note: Letter/authorization from the condo board or HOA; no government form.

name: Room Tax Monthly Return
download_note: Official CTPR portal for filing the monthly room-tax declaration and paying online.

name: LUMA Interconnection Registration
download_note: Official LUMA form (Rev. 10/2021); the interconnection/net-metering registration package is also filed through LUMA's GD portal.

name: Net Metering Agreement
download_note: Official LUMA interconnection/net-metering agreement for corporations (Anejo F2, rev. 11/8/22).

name: OGPe Construction Permit
download_note: Construction permits are filed 100% electronically via OGPe's Single Business Portal.

name: Property Owner Authorization Affidavit
agency_note: Not government-downloadable — issued by a Puerto Rico notary public of the user's choice.
download_note: Sworn statement executed before a PR notary; no government form. The notary prepares it.

name: OPPE Installer Registration Evidence
download_note: Official PPPE (DDEC energy program) application for renewable-systems installer certification, rev. Feb 2025; submitted by email to energia@ddec.pr.gov or in person.

name: DTRH Employer Registration (Unemployment & Disability Insurance)
agency: Departamento del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos (DTRH)
agency_canonical: Departamento del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
download_note: Employer registration for unemployment and disability insurance (seguro por desempleo e incapacidad) is a separate DTRH process from CFSE workers' compensation. Filed through the DTRH patronos portal.

name: ASUME Child Support Clearance Certification
agency: Administración para el Sustento de Menores (ASUME)
agency_canonical: Administración para el Sustento de Menores
download_note: Hacienda requires the ASUME certification (Certificación de la Administración para el Sustento de Menores) as a prerequisite for internal-revenue licenses, including alcohol beverage licenses. Request through ASUME/Familia offices.

name: Annual Report / Annual Fee (Informe Anual)
download_note: Filed with the Department of State on or before April 15 each year: corporations file the Informe Anual (Art. 15.01(A), Law 164-2009); LLCs pay the annual fee with basic company info (Art. 21.03(C)).
citation: Art. 15.01(A), Law 164-2009 (Ley General de Corporaciones); Art. 21.03(C) annual fee for LLCs; due April 15 each year.
